descriptions.g1c_box_hierarchy_mask_800bd53c: Traverse original32-byte external box hierarchy nodes. Compare both vector differences to the supplied margin; reject a node by advancing its witnessed subtree skip and emitting one zero bit for every witnessed leaf, or descend/emit a set bit for accepted leaves. Flush32-bit masks at wrap and the final word into externally supplied receiver storage beginning128. Native three-float subtraction temporaries are complete types. Receiver/node storage is external, with no constructed owner, guessed output-array extent, or owned data.
